title: Dense integration of compact topological photonic crystal cavities | EECS at UC Berkeley
content: Dense integration of compact topological photonic crystal cavities | EECS at UC Berkeley Dense integration of compact topological photonic crystal cavities Yertay Zhiyenbayev EECS Department, University of California, Berkeley Technical Report No. UCB/ December 1, 2025 Photonic crystals allow for light manipulation and control of the photonic density of states. This work demonstrates that breaking edge-mirror symmetry is advantageous for compact single-mode cavities based on the valley-Hall effect. This can lead to dense integration of an array of topological photonic crystal cavities.
